name: Arslantepe Mound
description: Arslantepe is a 30-metre-high mound near Malatya in eastern Türkiye, built up from some 6,000 years of settlement, from mudbrick houses to Hittite-era levels. Its fifth-millennium-BCE palace complex shows an early state, run by a bureaucracy that kept records before writing existed. Excavators also found the world's earliest known swords, which the local elite displayed to show their power.
